interpretation: Recorded native lesson success counters and success fractions are zero. Their ended/failure/timeout fields are means of cumulative integers across 24 policy frames, so endpoint differences are not exact ended-episode counts/rates. These receipts do not contain hold-gate tags; no particular failed gate has been established.

dynamic_lessons.prefix_stand: upright/easy start, zero initial release, followup vx/yaw set to zero; original success gates retained
dynamic_lessons.prefix_release: medium authenticated geometric start, scheduled native zero-torque release, original followup command; original success gates retained
dynamic_lessons.original_chain: original start and release/followup, only this lesson credits full_chain

lesson_scope.static_group_limit: A static original-scenario label can contain all dynamic lessons; static group successes/failures cannot be called original-chain outcomes.

gates.conditions: elapsed>=initial_release; prior interval is native zero active torque with gas springs retained. Prelude time includes release. prefix_release duration uses actual actor-clock schedule rounded to .005s.

PREPARE stable sensor conjunction, remaining reference error<.02rad and measured error<.12rad continuously .1s, then .2s torque BLEND to RL. Script budget8s including initial release at adapter; configured complete_started_blend permits an already-started blend to finish. Nonfinite sensors, route failures and takeover tilt>45deg can terminate.

conditions.support: deployable observer plausible: conditional FK height>.12m, paired-height difference<.035m, acceleration norm(6,16)m/s2, gyro norm<8rad/s
conditions.body_clear: (support probe confirmed or BLEND/RL) and plausible and estimated minimum height>.27m

gates.clock: Only RL holding lanes increment FSM stable_ticks; any failed gate resets current dwell, positive broken dwell increments break counter. Motion released once dwell>=1s.

conditions: enabled and pure_rl (release finished, FSM RL, no FSM failure or premature release)
both actual wheel contacts and no undesired contact
actual height within .05m of followup height
body xy speed<.25m/s before first observed release
gates.clock: Separate true_stable_seconds/peak from FSM sensor dwell. First observed motion-release interval still belongs to hold; after-release motion cannot create missing evidence. First release with actual peak<1s causes premature_release failure.

conditions: For required platform height>0: sampled terrain surface matches target platform within .001m for both wheels
wheel bottoms within .025m of target platform for both wheels
gates.flat: required_platform_height=0 does not require platform gate; actual_stable still requires actual contact/tilt/height.

conditions: FSM motion_released and actual hold peak was already>=1s
stand followup (abs vx/yaw<.01) additionally actual body xy speed<.10m/s
gates.clock: followup_seconds resets on any incomplete condition; true_success at>=1s and not failed. This is separate from stationary_10s quality metric.

gates.conditions: Mechanical failure takes precedence over success and horizon; blocked suppresses success. Horizon20s or boundary/blocked are collection timeout only without failure/success. Prelude masks generic fall/nonwheel/jump timeouts, not mechanical limits, recovery_script/actor/premature_release or collection horizon. Recovery success directly overrides generic success_hold, so there is no extra generic1s gate.

existing_training_TB.hold_denominator: per-policy sample recovery.enabled & FSM holding_rl count; clamp_min(1), therefore every gate fraction is zero when no lane is holding. Marginal pass fractions only, not joint stable fraction or continuous1s probability. Shared across all recovery lessons.
existing_training_TB.peak_and_break_denominator: Mean of FSM per-lane peak and break count across all4096 lanes, including non-recovery lanes. This sensor peak is not actual recovery_rl_stable_s.
existing_training_TB.ownership_denominator: all4096 lanes; eligible_policy includes ordinary non-recovery lanes, not a recovery-only takeover success rate.
existing_training_TB.logger: rsl_rl/utils/logger.py:185 averages ep_extras over rollout24policy frames before writing; use identical complete dense windows and report time-average with population, never infer exact episode counts.
existing_training_TB.read_existing_event_only: Reuse frozen reader parse_events(event_path, set(tags plus hold_population/peak/break/ownership), end_step=29438, min_step=29389), then stats on all50 dense steps; reject missing tags/partial coverage. Same attempt003 event only, no new curve source.

currently_unlogged_training_gate_details.warning: Fields available as native extras diagnostics are not automatically TB tags; LearningAudit does not serialize the recovery diagnostic masks. Do not claim actual per-lesson gate evidence from the current reader output.

native_mean_comparison_watch.diagnostic_order: First inspect evidence and failure_code plus script_seconds, blend/handover; next pure_rl and rl_stable_s; next platform_retained and motion_released; finally followup_s/true_success plus actual speed/yaw/height/tilt and termination reasons.
native_mean_comparison_watch.scope: Standard63 fixed evaluation uses restored predecessor exact cases and removes training prefix sampler; its original recovery episodes are deterministic actor-mean policy tests of original chains, not fresh prefix_stand/prefix_release training success rates. RequestProtocolMetrics records actual terminal rows independent of TB averaging. Standard traces have velocity/omega/height but do not dump every recovery gate mask.
native_mean_comparison_watch.trace_limit: Existing standard trajectories contain actual velocity/omega/height, but only representative IDs and only when traces enabled. Final per-episode report fields alone cannot reconstruct the time at which a hold predicate broke.

recommendation: Read existing native hold-gate tags with complete-window CRC coverage and holding population; use existing standard63 episode ledger for phase/actual-hold/followup failures. Do not alter reward, exploration, command, source, budget or sampling to explain the zero counters.
